name: Orbital Monks
summary:
Orbital Monks

Step into the vast unknown and carve your path through the cosmos in Orbital Monks, a space exploration and scavenging experience built for VR.

Drift between planets, abandoned stations, and asteroid fields as you search for valuable scrap scattered across space. Every discovery has value—salvage what you can, manage your inventory, and return to trade hubs to sell your findings for credits.
